stages.journal: Coppin laid a chart on the tally desk and tapped it twice. The kobold tunnels don't wander — they aim, straight at the deep chamber where the star-stone fell. Whatever they want with it, the Reeve wants a working gallery more. Clear the diggers off the front, and mind the far chamber: something with too many legs has made a nest where the miners should be.

The front is quiet and the Reeve's ledger is open to a new page. Prove the galleries pay again: six measures of silver ore off the deep lodes, cut by your own pick. The silver walks are past the junction, east — take a light. The sweepers don't go that far.
